developer.name: Muhammad Afzal Soomro
developer.title: Full-Stack Developer
developer.summary: Full-stack developer focused on building responsive web applications, backend APIs, and modern user experiences using TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js. Dedicated to clean architecture, reliable data flow, and practical problem solving.

projects.title: Zentrix Store
projects.summary: Full-stack e-commerce web platform engineered for modern online retail. Features an intuitive product browsing experience, responsive product detail pages, client-side cart state management, and optimized checkout flow.
highlights: Dynamic product filtering and category-based catalog browsing
Persistent cart interactions with real-time total calculations
Fully responsive mobile-to-desktop layout with accessible controls
projects.architectureNotes: Built using Next.js with component modularity separating UI presentation from cart state logic. Utilizes Tailwind CSS for adaptive styling across all device viewports.

projects.title: Real Estate Lead Management API
projects.summary: Specialized backend REST API service designed for real estate lead intake, validation, qualification, and routing. Streamlines incoming property inquiries and manages lead life cycles for agent handoff.
highlights: Standardized lead ingestion endpoints with strict payload validation
Status tracking workflow (New, Contacted, Qualified, Closed)
Automated routing logic based on agent availability and property criteria
projects.architectureNotes: Under active development. Focuses on decoupled route controllers, robust request schema validation, and structured error propagation.
